title: Shawarma Chicken Noodle Bowl
description: A flavorful and authentic Shawarma-inspired dish with chicken, noodles, and vegetables. This recipe combines the best of the Middle East in a delicious and easy-to-make meal.

ingredients.name: shawarma spice blend
ingredients.notes: or a mix of cumin, coriander, and paprika

instructions: 1. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
3. Add the chopped tomato and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
4. Add the chicken breast to the skillet and cook until browned on both sides and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
5. In a separate pan, cook the oriental noodles according to the package instructions.
6. In a small bowl, mix together the shawarma spice blend and a pinch of salt.
7. Add the spice blend mixture to the cooked chicken and toss to coat.
8. Assemble the noodle bowls by placing a portion of noodles on a plate, followed by the cooked chicken, chopped vegetables, and a dollop of tzatziki sauce.
